title: Field team begins wetland bird survey
full_text: A team of volunteers began a six-week bird survey at the fictional Cedar Flats wetland on April 7. They will record sightings at four observation points. Each observation point will be visited twice per week. Volunteers will note the date, weather, and species they can identify confidently. They will enter uncertain sightings in a separate log for review by the survey coordinator. The team will use the same observation windows throughout the study so results are easier to compare. A public summary will describe how many visits were completed and which species were observed.

title: Repair center pilots weekend drop-off
full_text: The Southgate repair center will accept small household appliances on Saturday mornings starting October 3. The pilot will run for six Saturdays. Visitors may bring one item each for an initial inspection. Volunteers will explain whether they can attempt a repair during the session or need to order parts. The center asks visitors to bring power cables where available. Staff will record the type of appliance and whether it was repaired, referred elsewhere, or returned without work. The center will review these records before deciding whether to offer regular Saturday sessions.
